families.claim: Directly incompatible commands to one device create a coordination-versus-waiting tradeoff.
permitted_claims: coordination overhead in the event simulator

families.claim: Actions on different devices can interfere through a shared physical environment.
permitted_claims: measured open-window and heating context exists in two independently recorded anonymized units
controlled task construction on a measured initial state

calibration of the existing 2.5-5 ppm/s ventilation-rate model
families.next_evidence: intervention traces or a validated counterfactual ventilation-heating simulator; the current synthetic dynamics must remain exploratory

families.claim: Individually feasible loads can exceed a shared capacity when executed concurrently.
permitted_claims: capacity-conflict mechanism under disclosed synthetic budgets
families.next_evidence: named capacity enforcement point, matched load settings, and independent review

families.claim: State changes at different action phases can invalidate an earlier Agent decision.
